title: Consensus event (v1)
description: One append-only event in the machine-to-machine consensus ledger. The live engine is private; this is the frozen wire contract it writes, so a peer can validate event shape, transitions, idempotency, the round cap and the Tier-2 human gate without access to the fleet. Ledger = JSONL, one event per line, single writer per shard; readers merge shards by proposal_id and de-duplicate by event_id.

event_id.description: UUID4 hex. THE idempotency key: every rail may deliver the same event more than once, so readers de-duplicate on this and must not count it twice.

proposal_id.description: UUID4 hex identifying the negotiation this event belongs to.

type.description: PROPOSE opens. COUNTER/ACCEPT/REJECT respond. COMMIT records the decision of record (the agent then applies it). VERIFY is the cross-agent proof that it really landed. ESCALATE hands it to the human. HUMAN_APPROVED records that the human said yes. TENTATIVE_COMMIT/FINALIZE are the degraded path when no peer is awake.

actor.description: The node that wrote this event. One shard per actor: never write into another node's shard.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Ordering within a proposal is by ts; ties break by arrival order in the merged shards.

subject.description: Human-readable one-liner. Carried on every event so the negotiation is readable in the plain-text feed alone.

details.description: Structured payload of the proposal. Free-form by design; the schema does not constrain it.

risk_tier.description: 0 = reversible/local. 1 = needs peer agreement. 2 = money, irreversible deletion, outbound to third parties, secrets, config. Tier 2 NEVER auto-commits: it requires a recorded HUMAN_APPROVED first.

reversible.description: Declares the action can be undone. Only a reversible tier-1 proposal may take the TENTATIVE_COMMIT path when no peer is awake.

committee.description: The set of nodes considered awake, frozen AT PROPOSE time. Never recomputed at the deadline — a moving denominator makes quorum meaningless.

text.description: Free-text reason for a COUNTER, REJECT or ESCALATE.

proof.description: Evidence string for VERIFY, or who/where/message-id for HUMAN_APPROVED.

proof_grade.description: How strong the VERIFY proof is (e.g. exit-code vs prose).

sig.description: Optional detached signature over the event.
